agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report, the Board of Commissioners' Oversight Report, and the Audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting a full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Commissioners and Directors. The audit was performed by Maria Leckzinska of KAP Mirawati Sensi Idris.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the allocation of the 2025 net profit of USD 230,539,143, with USD 100,000 for mandatory reserves and the remainder for retained earnings. No cash dividends were declared for this period.
Agenda #3: The meeting approved amendments to Articles 3 and 20 of the Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI) and authorized the Board of Directors to handle all legal formalities. These changes include adjustments for the Online Single Submission system.
Agenda #4: Shareholders dismissed Timotius Max Sulaiman as Director and appointed Marlo Budiman as Vice President Director, establishing a board of 6 Commissioners and 8 Directors. The terms for the newly established board members are set to end on June 30, 2029.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved a maximum 9% increase in remuneration for existing board members for the 2026 fiscal year based on performance and economic conditions. The President Commissioner was authorized to determine the pay for any new directors.
Agenda #6: Leo Susanto from KAP Mirawati Sensi Idris was appointed to audit the 2026 consolidated financial statements. The Board of Directors was authorized to appoint a replacement if necessary and determine the audit honorarium.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved the pledging of more than 50% of the company's net assets in one or more transactions. The Board of Directors was authorized to execute all necessary legal actions related to these transactions.
Agenda #8: The company presented reports regarding the realization of funds from Sustainable Bonds I Stages II, III (2024), and IV (2025). This agenda item was for shareholder information and required no formal decision.
Agenda #9: The meeting presented reports on the use of funds from Sustainable Sukuk Mudharabah I Stages II, III (2024), and IV (2025). This item was provided for information purposes and did not require a vote.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Approval of capital reduction through withdrawal of buyback shares and amendment to the Articles of Association. The meeting approved reducing authorized capital from Rp600 billion to Rp596 billion and issued/paid-up capital from Rp192.638 billion to Rp188.785 billion by cancelling 3.85 billion shares, and authorized the Board of Directors to amend the Articles of Association accordingly.
Agenda #2: Approval of changes in the composition of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors. The meeting accepted the resignations of Franky Oesman Widjaja as President Commissioner and David Fernando Audy as Director, granted them release and discharge, appointed Audy as President Commissioner, and determined the full composition of both boards, with six commissioners and seven directors, including Lay Krisnan Cahya as President Director.
Agenda #3: Granting authority to the Board of Directors and/or Corporate Secretary for notarial deed and filings. The meeting granted authority to the Board of Directors and/or Corporate Secretary, jointly or individually, to state the resolutions in a notarial deed, appear where required, prepare and execute documents, notify authorities of management changes, and take all necessary actions.
